title: Polynomial-time preimages of alternating classes
statement: Let $b\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, let $i\in\mathbb N$, and let $L$ be a language in the alternating class of level $i$ whose first quantifier is specified by $b$. If $f$ is a polynomial-time computable function on bit strings, then the preimage $\{x:f(x)\in L\}$ also belongs to that same alternating class.
hypotheses_covered: $b$ is a Boolean value specifying the first quantifier
$L$ belongs to the alternating class at level $i$ with first quantifier $b$
